summary: Verified frontend-only SuperClinic app after data-testid re-application in App.jsx/SuperSummary.jsx. App loads with NO blank/white screen and ZERO console errors on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). Tested full end-to-end flows: Home -> ClinicFlow -> complaint select -> consultation Q&A -> Generate Note -> NoteScreen (Copy/New Patient) all working. Home -> SuperSummary -> Template Library tabs -> Public template card -> modal (Smart Editor / AI Wizard) -> FillScreen (Copy/Close) all working. Template Editor (New Template) with name/diagnosis/body/save/cancel all working. MoProPrep and DnbProPrep cards correctly open external URLs (moproprep.in, dnbproprep.com) in new tabs via window.open. FOUND AND FIXED a critical bug: the local `Btn` component inside SuperSummary.jsx did not accept/forward the `testId` prop to the DOM, silently breaking 42 data-testid attributes across the entire file (fillscreen-copy-btn, fillscreen-close-btn, new-template-btn, flow-option-smart-editor-btn, flow-option-ai-wizard-btn, template-editor-save-btn, etc. were all present in JSX but never rendered in the DOM). Also found 'launch-supersummary-btn' was missing entirely on the home SuperSummary card in App.jsx. Both fixed and re-verified working.
action_items: No further action required for this pass - both bugs found were fixed and re-verified.

Note: option buttons for the sequential Q&A screen use data-testid=`option-btn-${i}` (matches problem statement) while the alternate fast-track/multi-question review renderer (opdQuestions block ~line 2570) uses a different naming pattern data-testid=`opd-option-${qObj.key}-${opt}` - this is fine/intentional since they are two different components, just documenting for future testers to avoid confusion.
critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL BUG (fixed): `Btn` component defined locally in SuperSummary.jsx (line ~12) did not destructure/forward the `testId` prop, so all 42 `<Btn testId=...>` usages in that file rendered without any data-testid in the DOM despite looking correct in JSX. Fixed by adding `testId` to the destructured props and passing it as `data-testid={testId}` on the underlying <button>. Also added testId forwarding to the local `Card` component in the same file for future-proofing (no current usages needed it, but kept parity with App.jsx's Card).
Minor: `launch-supersummary-btn` data-testid was missing on the SuperSummary home card CTA button in App.jsx (line ~2895) while sibling cards had theirs. Fixed - added the testid.

App.jsx is 3026 lines and SuperSummary.jsx is 2287 lines - both well beyond the 700-line guideline, consistent with prior iteration's feedback; recommend future refactor to split into smaller components (LibraryScreen, ConsultationScreen, TemplateLibrary, FillScreen, TemplateEditor as separate files).

success_rate.frontend: 100% after fix (was ~85% before fix due to broken testId forwarding in SuperSummary.jsx)

test_credentials: None required - frontend-only app, no auth
context_for_next_testing_agent: Confirmed working end-to-end in this pass, with screenshots: (1) Home page desktop+mobile, no console errors, no blank screen. (2) Home cards (ClinicFlow, SuperSummary, SuperMemory, MoProPrep, DnbProPrep) - all data-testid present and clickable (home-card-*, launch-clinicflow-btn, launch-supersummary-btn [fixed], open-supermemory-btn, play-learn-btn, prep-dnb-btn). (3) ClinicFlow full flow: library-screen -> complaint-card click -> age/sex inputs -> Start Consultation -> option-btn-{i}/custom-answer-input/send-custom-answer-btn/voice-toggle-btn all present and functional -> generate-note-btn enables after ~5 answers -> NoteScreen with copy-note-btn/new-patient-btn working, note text renders correctly with red flags/differentials. (4) SuperSummary flow: template-tab-public/my-templates/community/ai all present -> template-card-{id} click opens modal with flow-option-smart-editor-btn/flow-option-ai-wizard-btn -> Smart Editor -> FillScreen with fillscreen-copy-btn/fillscreen-close-btn (these were broken before fix, now working) -> new-template-btn -> Template Editor modal with template-name-input/template-diagnosis-input/template-sample-body-textarea/template-editor-save-btn/template-editor-cancel-btn all present and functional. (5) Mobile viewport (390x844) renders both home and library screens correctly without layout breakage. (6) MoProPrep/DnbProPrep cards open correct external URLs in new tab (verified via page.expect_popup). Zero console errors observed across all flows tested.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: When data-testid attributes were re-applied to SuperSummary.jsx after the git branch sync wiped them, the developer added `testId` as a prop on ~42 `<Btn testId="...">` JSX call sites, but did not update the `Btn` function component's own signature/destructuring to accept and forward that prop to the underlying `<button>` element's `data-testid` attribute (SuperSummary.jsx defines its own local Btn component, separate from App.jsx's Btn which already correctly forwards testId). This meant the attributes were present in source code (passing a naive grep check) but never actually rendered in the live DOM, which would have caused all Playwright/automated tests relying on those SuperSummary testids to silently fail. Fix: updated the Btn (and Card, for parity) component definitions to destructure `testId` and render `data-testid={testId}` on the output element.
